text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Held during the summer
to hone skills—the summer training camp—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, yeah, got it. I'll be careful not to get hurt. Later.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm all settled with Mane-G.
So that means zero contact during the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I can focus purely on training.
choice_data_list: Are you going to keep the power off until it's over?
Are you keeping the power off until it's over?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
At the Kikuka Sho,
I have to show everyone how strong I've become.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Then we can't be doing things half-assed, can we?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if I wanna repay my manager
for rearranging my schedule, I just have to keep growing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, I'm counting on you starting today.
—You better bring your A-game, too!"
